source.check: names and divisions read on the page image of the Belfast News-Letter nominations report of 9 May 1930

note: Nomination-day report for the twenty-two divisions of Antrim rural district, one member each. Twenty-one candidates were returned unopposed or deemed re-elected; Antrim Urban was contested by Mr. J. T. Smith, J.P., and Mr. S. W. Brennan, J.P., and the result of that poll was not traced in the reports searched. The round is filed on the rural districts' polling day in early June 1930 (queue nominal 29 May). Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
